cell_witness.summary: Captured first-hit inner-helper callsite and post-effective-span state for the requested low-span, quality-strong, and edge-prepass representatives. The exact per-cell scatter body/table-step trace was interrupted by second-chance access violations after the effective span was recorded; therefore this return provides typed closest local values rather than a full accumulation/denominator/writeback witness.

inner.next_evidence: Typed FUN_180001c90 per-cell witness for one low-span cell and one Quality/strong cell.

witness_plan.recommended_action: Do not promote global Inner toggles. If Windows is needed, trace one representative low-span cell and one Quality/strong cell; add Edge Fade prepass only if the first two do not explain the split.

representatives.required_proof: Typed FUN_180001c90 values for one low-span cell: resolved span, table index, row/underflow target, source/destination polar cell, and accumulated RGBA/denom.
representatives.why: Low-span/offset cases prefer circular-wrap-like behavior and regress under loop-minus-one.

representatives.required_proof: Typed FUN_180001c90 values for one Quality/strong cell: resolved span, loop bound, table divisor, gaussian weight, source row, and post-scatter accumulation.
representatives.why: Strong/high-Quality cases prefer loop-minus-one-like behavior but still keep max residuals.

representatives.required_proof: Prepass alpha/factor plane and scatter denominator values for one Edge Fade cell before changing table bounds.
representatives.why: Edge Fade cases prefer table-span-minus-one-like behavior and exercise the prepass alpha tables.

recommended_action: Do not promote broad RadialBlur toggles from PNG matrices. Zoom is alpha-normalization/sampler-side; tiny Rotation needs sampler/validity proof; Inner needs typed per-cell helper evidence.

tiny_rotation.classification: inverse-sampler / validity-side unresolved; not explained by a simple final byte conversion tie
tiny_rotation.next_evidence: Exact inverse-sampler validity/border and pre-writeback path for the high-max top-border witness.

zoom.interpretation: RGB floats are essentially matched at the Zoom witness, but local alpha is clipped to 1.0 while the Windows trace returns 0.99999994. The remaining max=1 alpha residual is upstream of final byte packing and should be treated as sampler/alpha-normalization state, not a writeback conversion rule.
zoom.next_evidence: Zoom polar alpha/sample accumulation; not final byte packing.
